headline: Frontline Shifts Intensify Across Six Theatres
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the pace of base turnover has quickened on the most contested fronts. Weathered Expanse remains the hottest sector, recording 52 ownership changes in the past day; colonial casualties have risen to 9,343 and Warden losses to 14,530 while fresh enlistments climb to 519. Stlican Shelf follows with 47 flips, colonial dead up to 2,508 and Warden dead to 2,659, enlistments 312. Fishermans Row logs 39 flips, colonial casualties 852 and Warden casualties 987, enlistments 330. Callahans Passage shows 21 flips, colonial losses now 12,124 and Warden losses 14,433, enlistments 846. Mooring County reports 12 flips, colonial casualties 5,093 and Warden casualties 5,557, enlistments 602. Nevish Line adds 9 flips, colonial dead 5,032 and Warden dead 4,304, enlistments 510. All other regions report no ownership changes in the last 24 hours, with casualties and enlistments largely static.
